findings.message: effect is created without a reactive owner; nothing will ever dispose it, so it keeps running and holding its subscriptions for the lifetime of the app
findings.hint: Create effects inside a component or computation so their owner disposes them. For deliberate module-scope reactivity, wrap the setup in createRoot(dispose => ...) and keep the dispose handle.

findings.message: createMemo() is called in an inline callback written in the apply callback of a createEffect; whenever it runs, it runs with no owner inside the effect phase, where the installed @solidjs/signals throws PRIMITIVE_IN_EFFECT_CALLBACK in dev before the computation is created, and the production build creates one that belongs to nobody and is never disposed
findings.hint: Create it in the effect's compute function or in the component body, or parent it explicitly: capture the owner (`const owner = getOwner()`) outside the effect and create it inside `runWithOwner(owner, () => …)`.
